purpose: Test whether a causal checkpoint sequence improves positive remaining-payoff prediction and negative veto value by eliminating economically bad compatible loop alternatives before the frozen anchor-plus-24 terminal time.

opened_data_status.permitted_claim: retrospective causal mechanism attribution or a frozen prospective logging hypothesis

inputs.provider_2023_status: full intermediate tape unavailable; frozen execution anchors retain anchor next-open and terminal prices only

already_tested: top predicted loop and absolute top-loop score
static loop by current-regime rolling profitability
realised parent-route completion and incompatibility as causal exit events
same-session and one-session-lag breadth/coherence payoff overlays
not_previously_tested: normalised compatible-loop posterior with explicit unknown residual
training-only good bad unknown economic classification for every compatible competitor
one-versus-rest structural elimination through registered checkpoints
sequential bad-mass fall versus identical anchor-only odds
constant-terminal remaining payoff after competitor resolution
fixed-population veto accounting with no replacement opportunities

hypotheses.target: paired first-elimination checkpoint prediction versus its own anchor-only forecast
hypotheses.expected_benefit: establish whether the causal sequence adds payoff information beyond the initial score mixture
hypotheses.safety_risk: future transitions or realised loop identity entering the checkpoint
hypotheses.validation: synthetic prefix-elimination tests and independent timestamp/posterior reconstruction
hypotheses.stop: reject if paired Brier and remaining-payoff increment are not positive

hypotheses.target: losses avoided minus profits mistakenly rejected on an immutable base population
hypotheses.expected_benefit: identify a useful abstention overlay even without exact-loop prediction
hypotheses.safety_risk: replacement opportunities or overlap changes create a different population
hypotheses.validation: one source opportunity remains one accounting row under every policy
hypotheses.stop: reject operational value if veto value is non-positive or coverage becomes trivial

hypotheses.target: cycle_04 from state 4 and cycle_07 from state 5 only
hypotheses.expected_benefit: test the two frozen multiplicity-exposed mechanisms without replacement-family search
hypotheses.safety_risk: choosing a new family after observing failure
hypotheses.validation: contract and auditor pin named targets and controls
hypotheses.stop: retain a negative or descriptive conclusion when either named target fails

hypotheses.target: resolution-lag ratio and constant-terminal capturable payoff
hypotheses.expected_benefit: separate structural resolution from economically timely resolution
hypotheses.safety_risk: crediting payoff earned before the checkpoint
hypotheses.validation: next-open entry and original terminal clock are independently replayed
hypotheses.stop: classify as too late if most positive payoff is already unavailable

hypotheses.target: pre-session settled-payoff good bad unknown classifications
hypotheses.expected_benefit: test generalisation without static post-inspection family labels
hypotheses.validation: reuse only frozen no-leading-feature V2 forecasts with strict settlement support
hypotheses.stop: return insufficient support when good and bad mass cannot be established

population.primary_surface: breakout_loop_scores_range_p75 h24 source opportunities after the frozen 60-session warmup
population.or_stack_population: unavailable as an exact compatible source in the frozen ledger and therefore omitted

negative_control.selection_basis: frozen prior reports show negative h24 payoff in both opened periods

neutral_control.selection_basis: frozen prior reports classify support as too sparse for a directional conclusion

economic_classification.good: support passes, posterior mean is positive, and frozen one-sided 90 percent lower bound is above zero
economic_classification.bad: support passes and the reconstructed one-sided 90 percent upper bound is below zero
economic_classification.unknown: all other cases, including missing cells

structural_unit: opportunity anchor by stock by session by loop orientation by checkpoint
economic_support_unit: session by loop by orientation by fixed h24 horizon

posterior.initial_known_mass: the frozen causal loop_probability for every compatible loop at the anchor
posterior.initial_unknown_mass: one minus the sum of compatible raw loop probabilities; observed sums above one fail closed
posterior.candidate_orientation: parent cycle plus anchor current state
posterior.hard_elimination: zero only after the completed observed transition prefix is incompatible with every rotation beginning at the anchor state
posterior.completed_candidate: remains compatible after its registered parent path completes
posterior.training_history: all strictly earlier completed sessions inside the same period
posterior.loop_occurs_usage: training-only census label; never loaded for the scored anchor or checkpoint

context.history_token: frozen causal three-state token at the anchor or observed transition

checkpoints.availability: a transition checkpoint freezes only after the first bar carrying the new state has completed
checkpoints.primary_endpoint_checkpoint: the first registered event that eliminates at least one anchor-compatible loop, with at least six bars remaining

remaining_payoff.entry: next causally available provider open after checkpoint
remaining_payoff.direction: outcome-only frozen source direction, absent from posterior inputs
remaining_payoff.capturable_fraction_denominator: positive original net payoff only; non-positive denominators are missing
remaining_payoff.execution_interpretation: delayed admission is executable only after the original trigger direction is causally known; conditional payoff labels before that time are predictive targets only

decision.admit: good mass dominates bad mass, unknown and entropy pass, conservative expected remaining net is positive, support passes, and a good loop remains compatible
decision.reject: target named family is eliminated, or bad mass reaches the frozen veto threshold with non-positive conservative remaining net, or unresolved unknown survives until fewer than six bars remain

primary_comparison.treatment: full sequential transition dwell and clock posterior at first competitor-elimination event
primary_comparison.control: the identical full posterior frozen at that opportunity's anchor
primary_comparison.target: positive constant-terminal remaining net payoff at the first-elimination checkpoint

requirements: paired sequential prediction improves over anchor
losses avoided exceed profits rejected after costs
twice-cost and one-bar-delay stability where executable
independent audit and exact rerun pass
no realised loop identity or future state input
